item.title: Bovine pangenomes
item.description: Background on cattle Nucleotide diversity is higher in cattle than human populations. Pangenome might be even more useful in cattle for that reason. The reference genomes is from a highly inbred Hereford cow, one of the most common cattle in many countries. A typical B. taurus genome differs from that reference by ~7-8M SNPs/INDELs. Genome size ~2.76Gb 29 autosomes + X/Y Draft in 2004 Latest version is ARS-UCD1.
